radio.signal.bellwether.opening: Bellwether maintenance. Anyone still up there?
radio.signal.bellwether.arrival: Pump's on the bypass. We have water. We can't tell the depot what we need. Fuse was heating, so I isolated the supply at the generator. Spares are in the cabinet by the bench.
radio.signal.bellwether.local_restored: We can hear each other again. I'll get the depot request to the courier.
radio.signal.no_carrier: Static. No carrier on any channel you know.
message.signal.not_bound: This equipment isn't connected to anything here.
message.signal.generator.already_isolate: The isolator is already open. Supply isolated.
message.signal.generator.isolated: Isolator opened. Supply isolated; the bus is dead. Breaker settings are kept.
message.signal.generator.refused_fuse: Main fuse F1 is damaged. Closing the isolator onto it would cook it. Replace F1 at the distribution panel first.
message.signal.generator.closed: Isolator closed. Bus live: %s units available, %s units set at the panel.
message.signal.inspect.generator: Generator G1 - rated %s units. Isolator: %s. Reaching the bus: %s units. Set at panel: %s units. (Sneak + use to isolate.)
message.signal.inspect.pump: Pump P1 - demand %s units. State: %s. Header pressure: %s/3.
message.signal.inspect.relay: Regional relay R4 - demand %s units. Power: %s. Antenna: %s. Route: %s.
screen.signal.panel.title: Distribution Panel DP-1 - Bellwether Relay
screen.signal.preview.over: Short by %s. This allocation can't be applied on one generator.
screen.signal.preview.isolated: Fits, but the supply is isolated: services start when the isolator at G1 is closed.
screen.signal.preview.fault: Fits, but F1 is damaged and the supply is isolated. Nothing will run until F1 is replaced and G1's isolator closed.
screen.signal.preview.relay_no_route: The relay would have power, but its antenna is misaligned: it reaches nobody.
screen.signal.preview.fuse_ready: You carry a replacement F1. Supply is isolated: safe to fit.
screen.signal.preview.fuse_needed: No replacement F1 on you. Spares are in the cabinet.
screen.signal.panel.status.stale: Panel state changed since you looked. Refreshed - check and apply again.
screen.signal.panel.status.fuse_installe: F1 fitted. Close the isolator at G1 to restore supply.
screen.signal.panel.status.fuse_live: Refused: supply is live. Isolate at G1 first.
command.signal.scenario.exists: A SIGNAL campaign already exists in this world (anchor %s). Use /signal scenario status, or /signal scenario reset bellwether confirm.
command.signal.scenario.none: No SIGNAL campaign in this world.
command.signal.scenario.occupied: Refused: %s occupied block(s) or object(s) in the site area (first at %s). Area %s to %s must be natural terrain only. Use a fresh test world or another anchor.
command.signal.scenario.not_loaded: Refused: the site area %3$s to %4$s is not fully loaded. Stand closer to the anchor and try again.
command.signal.scenario.out_of_height: Refused: the site area %3$s to %4$s would extend outside the world's build height.
command.signal.scenario.created: Bellwether relay site created at %s (bounds %s to %s).
command.signal.scenario.rules: Scenario rules applied: mob spawning disabled (server-wide game rule). Revert with /gamerule doMobSpawning true.
command.signal.scenario.rules_weather: Scenario rules applied: mob spawning disabled (server-wide game rule; revert with /gamerule doMobSpawning true). Rain set for this dimension, then the normal weather cycle resumes.
command.signal.scenario.player_ready: You are now in Adventure mode at the maintenance road with a handheld radio; your spawn point is set here. Walk east to the service yard.
command.signal.scenario.reset_warning: Reset rebuilds everything inside %s to %s and starts a new campaign timeline. Nothing outside is touched. Run /signal scenario reset bellwether confirm to proceed.
command.signal.scenario.reset_done: Bellwether site rebuilt; new campaign timeline started.
